Several donor management platforms offer **QuickBooks integration**, including **DonorSnap**, **Donorbox**, **DonorPerfect**, **CharityEngine**, **Bloomerang**, **DonorDock** (via Zapier), and **OnlineGiving.org**.[1][2][3][6][7][8][9]

If you want the most direct options, the main differences are:

| Software | QuickBooks support | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| **DonorSnap** | QuickBooks Online and Desktop | Automatic transaction sync to the general ledger at no extra cost; can also link donor records to QuickBooks customers.[1] |
| **Donorbox** | QuickBooks Online | Native integration that syncs donations, ticket sales, and transactions; listed as a $50/month add-on.[2] |
| **DonorPerfect** | QuickBooks Online | Syncs gifts and expenses, supports posting to the general ledger, mapping to customers, classes, and bank accounts.[3][5] |
| **CharityEngine** | QuickBooks Online and Enterprise | Offers detailed sync or batch sync; Enterprise users can export via IIF.[6] |
| **Bloomerang** | QuickBooks Online and Desktop | Syncs donor transactions and supports mapping to accounts and fields.[7] |
| **DonorDock** | QuickBooks Online | Integration is through Zapier, not native.[8] |
| **OnlineGiving.org** | QuickBooks Online and Desktop | Supports batch deposits, account/class mapping, and OAuth authentication.[9] |

If you are choosing software based mainly on accounting workflow:
- Choose **DonorSnap** or **Bloomerang** if you want **Online + Desktop** support.[1][7]
- Choose **Donorbox** if you only need **QuickBooks Online** and want a native donation sync.[2]
- Choose **DonorPerfect** or **CharityEngine** if you want more advanced nonprofit accounting mapping and reporting options.[3][6]
- Choose **DonorDock** if you are comfortable using **Zapier** for the connection.[8]

If you want, I can also narrow this to:
- the **cheapest** option,
- the **best for small nonprofits**,
- or the **best QuickBooks Online-only** choice.
